requirements.normative_requirement: Every enabled standard computer tool and user shell path is covered by the boundary or strict activation fails.
requirements.primary_verification: Dynamic tool-ownership inventory, post-activation registration test, and one bypass attempt per tool.

requirements.normative_requirement: Strict mode blocks undeclared model-callable host-effect tools at call time, not only at startup.
requirements.primary_verification: Register an undeclared tool after activation and prove the central tool-call guard blocks it.
